chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever you see sleeping on his face, wake him up."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about seeing someone sleep on their face?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs believers to rouse a person found sleeping on his face. The hadith teaches practical etiquette and concern for others through a simple, direct instruction.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1443 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If you see someone sleeping on their face, wake them up."
